notes.Luka Doncic: He has played 37 or 38 minutes in each of his last three games, including 37 points in 37 minutes Friday at Golden State. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard again, and Walker Kessler is available with a finger splint.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He played 35 minutes in Friday's blowout win over Chicago and 42 the game before, so Boston is not holding him back as he works back from the Achilles. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs and Jonathan Isaac.
notes.Franz Wagner: Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain) and Jalen Suggs (knee bone bruise) are out again, and he carried the offense Friday with 26 points and 11 assists in 39 minutes against Toronto.
notes.Pascal Siakam: Tyrese Haliburton, T.J. McConnell and Ivica Zubac are all out, and Obi Toppin is questionable with low back soreness. He played only 29 minutes in Friday's lopsided loss at Miami after double-doubles in 37 and 34 minutes, and his game has the highest total on the slate.
notes.Scottie Barnes: Kawhi Leonard is out again after missing the last two games with left knee swelling. Barnes scored a career-high 41 points on 19-of-34 shooting in 39 minutes Friday at Orlando before fouling out.
notes.Yaxel Lendeborg: Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler, Draymond Green and Kristaps Porzingis are all out, which leaves him as a top option. He fouled out after 24 minutes with six points Friday, but he had 31 and 26 points in the two games before.
notes.Brandin Podziemski: With Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler and Draymond Green all out, he becomes Golden State's main ball handler. He had 21 points and six assists in 33 minutes Friday against the Lakers.
notes.Keaton Wagler: Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Bradley Beal are out, and he has played 25 to 28 minutes off the bench in his last three games. He shot 2 of 11 Friday at Minnesota but still had 12 points and six rebounds.
notes.Darius Garland: He is playing through a back issue and scored 24 points in 31 minutes Friday at Minnesota. Brandon Ingram and Bradley Beal are out again.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: He runs the Indiana offense with Tyrese Haliburton and T.J. McConnell out. He had 18 points and 14 assists Wednesday and 22 points and nine assists Friday.
notes.Moritz Wagner: He had 16 points and eight rebounds in 23 minutes off the bench Friday at Detroit and is taking minutes from starter Day'Ron Sharpe. Egor Demin and Mikel Brown Jr. are out tonight.
notes.Quenton Jackson: He scored 24 points in 24 minutes off the bench Friday at Miami with Tyrese Haliburton and Obi Toppin out. Haliburton is out again, and Toppin is questionable with low back soreness.
notes.Isaiah Jackson: He started Friday at Minnesota and had 10 points, seven rebounds, four blocks and three steals, though he played only 22 minutes. Yanic Konan Niederhauser is out, so the starting center job is his.
notes.Brandon Williams: Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler and Draymond Green are all out, which opens up guard minutes. He has played 14 to 17 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games.
notes.Georges Niang: Golden State is without Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler and Kristaps Porzingis, so the frontcourt is thin. He had 11 points and five rebounds in 19 minutes Friday and started the game before.
notes.Aaron Nesmith: He is probable with a left hamstring strain. He started Friday at Miami but played only 21 minutes in the lopsided loss, after 27 minutes the game before.
notes.Jarace Walker: He has played 22 to 29 minutes off the bench in his last three games, with 14 points, six rebounds and four assists in 28 minutes Friday. Obi Toppin is questionable with low back soreness, which could push more frontcourt minutes his way.
notes.Noah Clowney: He has played 20 to 24 minutes in his last three games but scored only three points in each of the last two. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin and Mikel Brown Jr.
notes.Anthony Black: He started Friday against Toronto with Jalen Suggs out and had 17 points and 10 assists in 31 minutes. Suggs is out again.
notes.Obi Toppin: He is questionable with low back soreness after his back went out before shootaround Friday and he missed the game at Miami.
notes.Mitchell Robinson: He is questionable for rest. If he sits, Neemias Queta, who had 13 points in 20 minutes off the bench Friday, should take the starting center minutes.
notes.Neemias Queta: Mitchell Robinson is questionable for rest, which could make Queta the starting center. He had 13 points and six rebounds in 20 minutes off the bench Friday.
notes.Ziaire Williams: He is questionable after missing the Lakers' last two games.
notes.Ja'Kobe Walter: He has started the last two games with Kawhi Leonard out and played 32 minutes Friday at Orlando, though he scored only nine points. Leonard is out again.
notes.Walker Kessler: He is available with a splint on his left finger. He had 10 points, 13 rebounds and five blocks in 31 minutes Friday at Golden State.
